<thought>To obtain a valid retrosynthetic template for coupling two aldehydes into an alkene, I will search the template catalog using the correct bond format: broken C=O (6-8) and formed C=C (6-6). This should return a McMurry‑type coupling template that can be used in a single step from two equivalents of 4‑methoxybenzaldehyde.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["aldehydes"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
  "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
  "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
